inspection_summary: Inspected all 4,778 lines. This survey argues that finite-height zeta computations systematically overemphasize local zero gaps, Gram structure, and initial Riemann-Siegel terms. Its central mechanism separates a slowly varying carrier wave from local zero-spacing effects, realizes that mechanism in large Haar-unitary characteristic polynomials, relates the wave to mesoscopic density fluctuations, S(t), primes, log-correlation, and mollification, and uses those distinctions to audit five published reasons for doubting RH.
